## Purpose

The committed output of the simulation track. Every file here is written by a simulation module, carries the synthetic label and the digest of the plant spec it was built from, and is re-run in CI, which fails if it no longer reproduces. The results rank risks, find edge cases and feed trade studies and pages; they never close a hazard or verify a mitigation.

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/sim/results/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Simulation code | Result sets | JSON and Markdown, labelled synthetic |
| 2 | Plant spec | Result sets | spec digest recorded in each |
| 3 | CI | Result sets | --check / --compare: must reproduce |
| 4 | Result sets | Pages and figures | READMEs, scenes, front page, wiki |
| 5 | Result sets | Level-2 cross-check | search edge cases |
| 6 | Results | Safety lead | findings for review |
| 7 | Fidelity case (none yet) | Results | the only way a result could count as evidence |

**Explicitly excluded:** the models and their inputs (`sim/plant`, `sim/spec`, …), hand edits of any kind, and verification records (`verification/`), which these results cannot enter without a reviewed fidelity case.

## SysML model

[`ResultSets.sysml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/sim/results/ResultSets.sysml) is generated from the result files and validated with the project model by the OMG pilot in CI.
